# Spiritual Translation

** ¶3:**

Just as the divine calling forth of truth and the reciprocal turning of the will toward that truth are the very states that opened the mind to receive divine love and to send forth humble acknowledgment — on behalf of the celest ial will that had descended into combat with fals ities — so these same states of mutual calling and answering became the means of conjunction for Divine Truth and Divine Good themselves. The interior will, in its captivity among ev ils, sought and found the liberating truth proceeding from the Divine. And Divine Truth and Divine Good likewise sought the love that had gone forth from them into that combat — which is the celestial will itself — yet it was only through the calling of infl ux and the answ ering of reception that conjunction between them could be restored.

**¶4 :**

In this way, these recip rocal states became the means by which all the higher heavenly degrees could reach down to the interior will, and to the living affection that had become bound to spiritual death through conjunction with evil and falsity. They became the very means of regeneration, by which the interior will was elevated from its natural bondage. Through them, Divine Good and Divine Truth were restored to the will that had lost them . They are the pur ifying truths that cle anse the living affection from contamination by fals ity and self -love — being the means of interior illustration and the awakening of rememb rance of celestial origin — whether that living affection is held within a state of spiritual perception or whether it dw ells within the ou termost natural and corporeal mind.

reconstructions.reconstructed_text: The assent and the amen have come about from these great ones of the powers. They were given the name as the assent belongs to the summons and the amen belongs to the answer.

Just as the summons and the obedience are the ones that opened the portals of mercy and entreaty for the First Man, so they also became portals for the Mother of Life and the Father of the living. The First Man sought and found his redeemer. And also the Mother of Life and the Father of the living sought [and found] this runner, who came forth from them, who is the First Man; but the summons and the obedience became the portals for them.

Now, in this way they have become portals for the aeons of greatness towards the First Man, and the soul that was conjoined with death. They became helpers [and deliverers] of the First Man during his ascent. They gave him [the right hand of] the Father of Life and the Mother of Life [and raised him to the heights]. They are purifiers of the living soul, being helpers and bestowers of remembrance for it, be it either in [the light] in the tree or in the creation of flesh [and body].
[And in this manner] the assent and the amen go up to the ships, and they [call] upon him in the [great] power [of the light]. [...] as the [...] at a place [...].

fills.fill: and raised him to the heights
